text:
dara: Quick note from onboarding: sample apps still show direct status checks (if err.status === 429). Newbies copy it and miss header/body signal semantics. Can we standardize SDK errors + add a linter to catch direct numeric checks?

nate: +1. Problem summary: 1) Retry-After can be seconds, HTTP-date, or missing; 2) JSON body may contain retry_hint; 3) Retry-After: 0 means try immediately, not "no-retry".

alex: Proposed mapping for docs: 401->AuthError (retryHint: refresh-token if bearer), 403->PermissionError (no-retry), 429->RateLimitError (prefer body.retry_hint, else header, else exponential), 5xx->ServerError (exponential), other 4xx->ClientError (no-retry). Include httpStatus, headers, rawBody on errors.

emma: For SDK ergonomics: expose classes (TS/py) and concrete types (Go) plus helpers: IsRetryable(err), RetryAfter(err), RetryHint(err). Also add lint rule in sample-apps to flag patterns like `err.status === 429` and suggest `instanceof RateLimitError` or `IsRetryable(err)`.

ci-bot: ci/go-sdk #1012 failed: tests/retry_hint_test.go:27 -> expected RetryHint "retry-after" but got "none". Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/go-sdk/1012

nate: Looks like test harness didn't include the header variant. I'll update mocks to return numeric and HTTP-date forms and a body with retry_hint: "exponential".

dara: One tiny UX rule: keep human-facing message short and rely on `retry_hint` for machine behavior. That dramatically reduces ambiguous docs examples.

alex: I'll draft a tiny quickstart snippet showing idiomatic usage for TS/Go/Py and add it to onboarding. Example TS: `try { await client.generate() } catch (err) { if (err instanceof RateLimitError) { await sleep(err.retryAfter ?? estimate()); } else throw err }`.

emma: I'll add the linter and a pre-commit hook in sample-apps. Also add a unit test for `Retry-After: 0` to ensure SDK treats it as immediate retry.

nate: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/go-sdk/pulls/501 - adds typed errors, RetryAfter parsing, IsRetryable/RetryHint helpers, and tests.

ci-bot: merge pipeline started for PR 501.

dara: Great work — this should cut a bunch of onboarding tickets. Closing loop: update quickstart snippets, add lint, and add a short note in errors.md about `Retry-After: 0` semantics. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
